decisions.reason: As a multi-item yogurt line launched in 2023 and still carried in 2024, it fits the firm's organic dairy core and prior investment makes management likely to continue rather than admit a failed launch.

This 2024 mild sliced cheese is very close to the established cheese business and its dedicated webpage signals visible commitment, so management will likely give it more time and explain any weak start as temporary.
The 2024 sliced butter cheese also sits squarely in the firm's core range and public presentation on its own page supports continued backing instead of a rapid withdrawal.
